products.title: Dark Brown Cropped Sheepskin Leather Jacket
products.tagline: Cropped clean. Built in full grain.
intro: Cut to sit at the waist. A-grade full-grain sheepskin, finished in Pakistan. Soft in the hand, structured in shape, with minimal hardware in an understated dark brown.

items.title: Full-grain sheepskin
items.text: Soft and supple, with the natural grain intact.

items.title: Cropped to the waist
items.text: Shorter proportions that finish at the trouser waistband.

items.title: Minimal construction
items.text: A pointed collar, a clean front zip, two vertical welt pockets.

items.title: Snap-tab cuffs
items.text: Adjustable, with restrained metal hardware.

items.title: Made in Pakistan
items.text: Cut, assembled and inspected one by one by Klaev's leather craftsmen.

sections.heading: Materials and finish
paragraphs: A-grade full-grain sheepskin, chosen for a soft hand and a clean surface. Grain and tone vary a little from hide to hide. That is real leather, so no two jackets are identical.

sections.heading: Fit and sizing
paragraphs: S to XL. Shorter than Klaev's other leather jackets, it finishes at the waist. Take your usual size, or size up to layer heavy knitwear underneath.

items.text: Keep the jacket away from sharp objects.
Do not spray cologne or perfume directly onto the jacket.

sizeGuide.note: Measured on the jacket, in inches. Chest is the full chest, twice the width laid flat. Compare with a jacket you own.

products.title: Black Goatskin Suede Jacket
intro: Goatskin, finished as suede. Velvety in the hand, matte black on the surface. Light enough for autumn evenings and mild winters, when full leather feels too heavy. No visible branding. Just the suede.

items.title: Goatskin suede
items.text: Matte and velvety, with finer fibres than cowhide. Ages well with care.

items.title: Light
items.text: Layer it in autumn, or wear it alone through a mild winter.

items.title: Minimal
items.text: No logos, no loud hardware, no extra detail.

items.title: Smooth lining
items.text: A breathable cotton blend. Soft over a t-shirt or a thin knit.

items.title: Structured shoulders, relaxed body
items.text: Close at the shoulders, a little easier through the torso.

items.title: Made in Pakistan
items.text: Cut and finished by hand by a small team of craftsmen.

sections.heading: Materials
paragraphs: Goatskin suede has finer fibres than cowhide or lambskin, a softer hand and a deeper velvet texture. Klaev's goatskin comes from leading Pakistani tanneries that also supply international luxury houses. The surface is brushed and finished by hand, so no two jackets look identical up close.

items.text: Keep the jacket away from sharp objects.
Do not spray cologne or perfume directly onto the jacket.

sections.heading: Sizing
paragraphs: Sized by chest. M fits 38 to 40 in, L fits 40 to 42 in, XL fits 42 to 44 in. Between sizes, size up to layer. Full measurements are in the size guide.

products.title: Oxblood Lambskin Leather Jacket
products.tagline: Hand-waxed. Oxblood. Ages its own way.
intro: Full-grain lambskin, hand-waxed in Pakistan. A deep oxblood with highlights that shift in the light and deepen into a patina over time. The wax goes on panel by panel, so no two jackets match. A smooth lining and a structured fit. Refined, never formal.

items.title: Hand-waxed full-grain lambskin
items.text: It builds its own patina. No two age the same way.

items.title: Deep oxblood
items.text: Rich burgundy, with highlights that change with the light.

items.title: Smooth lining
items.text: Breathable and soft. Comfortable all day.

items.title: Structured fit
items.text: Close at the shoulders, slim through the torso, slightly tapered at the waist.

items.title: Solid metal hardware
items.text: YKK zips and brass studs that age with the leather.

items.title: Made in Pakistan
items.text: Cut and finished by hand, not on a factory line.

sections.heading: Materials
paragraphs: Lambskin from leading Pakistani tanneries that also supply international luxury brands. The wax is applied by hand, panel by panel, which is why each jacket builds its own pattern of highlights. The grain stays intact, and the leather softens with every wear.

items.text: Keep the jacket away from sharp objects.
Do not spray cologne or perfume directly onto the jacket.

products.title: Black Lambskin Leather Jacket
intro: Full-grain lambskin, finished by hand in Pakistan. Soft and supple, with a tailored fit that works over a tee, a knit or a shirt. A smooth, breathable cotton-blend lining, comfortable all day. The grain builds a patina as you wear it, so it looks better in year five than on day one.

items.title: Full-grain lambskin
items.text: The highest grade of real leather. Soft on day one, better with the years.

items.title: Smooth lining
items.text: A breathable cotton blend. Comfortable all day, easy over a shirt.

items.title: Tailored fit
items.text: Close at the shoulders, slim through the torso, sleeves ending at the wrist bone.

items.title: Solid metal hardware
items.text: YKK zips and brass studs.

items.title: Made in Pakistan
items.text: Cut and finished by hand by a small team of leather craftsmen.

items.title: Solid leather
items.text: Every panel cut from one piece. No bonded scraps, no glue, nothing to peel.
